question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the important role of people** in developing the economy and society.**
 
• The appropriate adjective should reflect the importance of **people's role.**
 
• "**Crucial**" fits well as it denotes something of great importance or essentiality.
 
• Other options ("**frantic**", "**hopeful**", "**hasty**") do not fit the context of describing the essential role of people in development.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2)**
